name: lens1_2026-10
description: The optics used for every capture up to and including 2026-10: Phantom VEO E-340L, 2048 x 1152 window, the current lens (telecentric: the magnification is the same at every depth, so the measurement volume is a box and 10 um/px holds through it; Ben, 2026-10-16), camera on its rail. One profile per optical set-up: a new lens, aperture, working distance or camera position is a new profile file, not a code edit (sizer 3.0.0 plan, Phase 0).
um_per_px_status: Recorded as calibrated before 2026-10 (STATUS, Settled). The falling beads of 2026-10-15 agree: sizer against certificate, slope 1.002. To be measured with the PS20 dot array (profile v2).

calibration.status: Provisional (sizer 3.0.0 Phase 3, 2026-10-16). The table is built on static beads through focus: 37.36 um (108 beads), 56.28 um (31 beads), 76.39 um (2 beads); Delta is held at the end beads' value beyond them. The falling beads check it from 37.36 to 155.8 um. Sizes beyond the table's beads stay provisional until static beads of those sizes (the big-bead through-focus series) or the PS20 reticle's dots (below 37 um; profile v2) are in.
calibration.size_measure: d_blaisot_um (blur.measure around the AI mask, as bead_calibration measured the beads)

lookup_table.beyond: Delta held at the end bead's value (flagged table_extrapolated)

calibration.below_smallest_bead: sized through the table up to chi_max, Delta held at the smallest bead's value, down to d_min, flagged table_extrapolated: one measurement volume for every size (Ben, 2026-10-16, option 1; the reticle's 28 / 19.8 um dots check it)

d_min_provisional.method: half-max (native or 4x upsample) after the edge correction
d_min_provisional.criterion: median bias within +-10 %, >= 90 % of droplets inside the volume found and passed
d_min_provisional.status: Provisional (sizer 3.0.0 Phase 2, 2026-10-16): an optics model checked against the beads. It matches them near focus (chi up to ~16 um); with more blur real beads grow 6-12 % faster than the model, so the limits for looser chi_max are optimistic. d_min_um is set in Phase 3 once chi_max is chosen; the reticle's 14-28 um dots measure it.

lens.note: Ben, 2026-10-16. To check: the PS20 reticle's dot array stepped through focus (spacing constant over +-5 mm).
